content: Variable min and max ranges in ECU Configuration Parameter definition 20 of 35  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 85: AUTOSAR_RS_ECUConfiguration Requirements on ECU Configuration AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The min and max ranges of ECU Configuration Parameters shall be variable in the ECU Configuration Parameter definition. Rationale: Relationships between variation and the min/max values are quite often in the definition of the ECU Configuration Parameter definition. Use Case: The max value for the NvRamBlockId can be either 255 or 65535, depending whether a 8- or 16-bit selection has been chosen. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
